Name: WebPageButtonPlugin
Author: Jan
Description: GPIO button control for a web page: the first press opens the configured web page full screen on top of the slideshow, the next press closes it again.

Settings.Name: GpioPin
Settings.Description: BCM pin number of the button (default: GPIO20). Restart the plugin after changing it.

Settings.Name: Url
Settings.Description: Address of the web page that is opened full screen (for example https://example.com or http://192.168.1.10:8123).

Settings.Name: DisplayServer
Settings.Description: Display server used by the browser window: wayland (default), x11 or auto.

Settings.Name: BrowserCommand
Settings.Description: Optional browser executable. Empty = detect chromium, chromium-browser, google-chrome or firefox automatically.

Settings.Name: ExtraBrowserArgs
Settings.Description: Optional additional command line arguments for the browser.

Services.description: Monitors the GPIO button and opens or closes the web page window.

Permissions.reason: Permanently monitors the GPIO button in the background.
